# Smart Radar Pro & Digital Studio Craft — Comprehensive Technical Specification

## 1. System Overview
Smart Radar Pro is a multi-modular intelligence platform accessible via Telegram (@SmartRadarProBot) and supported by custom digital engineering services by developer @vovan9805.

## 2. Crypto & Predictive Terminal Modules
- **CEX-to-CEX Arbitrage**: Live scanning of thousands of spot pairs across Bybit, Gate.io, Bitget, BingX, and MEXC. Real-time querying of blockchain nodes to confirm active deposit/withdrawal statuses, preventing fake spread traps.
- **Polymarket Whale Tracker**: On-chain tracking of top-performing Gnosis Safe wallets. Real-time alert broadcasts with direct clickable event links.
- **Prediction Spike Detector**: Identifies sharp probability movements (>55%) within short evaluation windows. Triggers Google Gemini AI to analyze breaking news and formulate concise rationale summaries.
- **Technical Scoring (/analyze)**: Synthesizes Trend, Momentum, and Macro factors. Employs horizontal volume profile Point of Control (POC), order book depth imbalance, and price/volume divergences.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Local AI agent integration. All API keys and private seeds remain on the user local workstation. Trade proposals are pushed to Telegram for 1-click manual authorization.
- **CoinMarketCap Integration**: Free API key binding for all users, enabling coin search, asset comparisons, and personal price trigger notifications.

## 3. B2B Lead Finder Engine
- **Multi-Map Scraping**: Automated data extraction across 2GIS, Yandex Maps, Google Maps, and Firecrawl.
- **No-Website Filter**: Flags active commercial businesses that lack web presence, creating high-converting leads for web developers and digital agencies.
- **Integrated Mini-CRM**: Allows status cycling (New, Contacted, In Negotiation, Client, Rejected) and unwanted card removal.
- **Outreach Automation**: Direct WhatsApp and Telegram (https://t.me/+) chat links, plus instant copyable pitch templates.

## 4. Custom Development Services
- **Websites & Landing Pages**: Built using iOS Liquid Glass design systems, sub-300ms loading speeds, mobile-first responsiveness, and structured SEO.
- **Telegram Bots**: Commercial bots supporting payments, gated communities, databases (SQLite/PostgreSQL), and Mini Apps.
- **Automation Scripts & Parsers**: High-reliability web scrapers with anti-bot bypass and automated export to Excel, CSV, or APIs.
- **Commercial Terms**: No fixed price packages. Every project is scoped and evaluated individually based on technical complexity.
